content: In order to assess the relative contributions of the global and local models to the performance of our approach, we ran an ablation study. This was done for each dataset both with the whole test set, as well as with a subset of long documents. The results for Pubmed and arXiv are shown in Table TABREF34 and Table TABREF35 , respectively. For statistical significance, as it was done for the general results in Section 4.5, we use the approximate randomization method BIBREF32 with the Bonferroni correction at ( INLINEFORM0 ).
